global_caption: The video contains 8 shots. It is a first aid tutorial in cool-toned watercolor picture book style, set in a cloud-filled tea pavilion within an Eastern mythical paradise. Two white travelers serve as subjects demonstrating airway obstruction and subsequent emergency procedures. The overall color palette features teal gray, frost blue, and pale ink white, with lighting dominated by diffused sky light through clouds and soft backlighting. The emotional tone remains consistently calm and focused.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, wide shot from a high angle. Foreground features floating clouds and copper bells at eaves; midground shows a wooden tea pavilion suspended over the sea of clouds; background displays layered fairy mountains and a pale blue sky. Cool diffused light envelops the pavilion. One traveler just takes a bite when suddenly chokes, leaning forward, shoulders jerking. The other traveler looks up from the opposite side of the table, noticing the anomaly. The camera slowly pushes forward, focusing attention for the upcoming instruction.
shot2: Shot 2 connects via hard cut from the previous shot, close-up, eye-level angle. Composition focuses on the upper body and neck of the choking person, with tea pavilion railings and swirling clouds in the background as minimal backdrop. The subject's face lies on the rule of thirds, throat and hands as visual focal points. Lighting continues with cool soft glow. Cloak and collar flutter slightly due to struggle. The lens performs slight handheld forward movement, intensifying urgency in symptom recognition.
shot3: Shot 3 connects via hard cut, extreme close-up, eye-level slightly off-center angle. Foreground blurs the rescuer’s reaching hand; midground clearly captures the moment the rescuer observes facial and throat reactions of the choking person; background remains pavilion pillars and cold mist. Soft backlight from behind and to the side outlines the silhouette. The camera holds still for half a second, then makes a small pan to follow the rescuer into position.
shot4: Shot 4 connects via hard cut, medium close-up, eye-level angle. Composition fully includes both individuals from waist up, rescuer’s arms forming clear crossing lines. Background simplified to pavilion railing and sea of clouds, ensuring hand placement is most prominent. Under cool diffused light, the rescuer demonstrates placing fist above navel, wrapping the other hand, then delivering continuous inward and upward thrusts. Movements are distinct and visible—each push shows elbow tightening, back stabilizing, patient’s torso briefly shifting, clothing and belt subtly vibrating with force. Camera performs slight push-in and maintains stable tracking during each thrust, emphasizing standard positioning and motion path.
shot5: Shot 5 connects via brief fade transition, overhead shot, full-to-medium composition. Stone platform centered, forming stable geometric structure. Foreground shows scattered snacks and overturned cup; background still reveals pavilion edge and flowing mist. Narratively, it naturally follows loss of responsiveness. Even cool soft lighting persists. The choking person suddenly loses consciousness. The rescuer immediately supports head and upper body, laying them smoothly onto the stone platform. Motion is continuous, avoiding abruptness, limbs settling naturally. Camera gently lowers from above, then stabilizes, ensuring clarity of the laying process.
shot6: Shot 6 connects via hard cut, extreme close-up, overhead slightly off-center angle. Edges of stone platform and wooden pavilion grain form leading lines, directing attention to inspection action. Diffuse reflection from clouds provides soft bright cool light. Actions are swift and accurate. Camera performs short push-in, allowing “呼救—检查” two steps to be completed cohesively within one shot.
shot7: Shot 7 connects via hard cut, medium shot, overhead angle. Composition centers patient’s chest. Rescuer’s hands stacked over lower middle sternum, arms vertical forming clear longitudinal lines. Background limited to partial stone platform and cold mist edge, minimizing distraction. Lighting continues with cool diffusion and subtle backlight outlining. Rescuer performs steady compressions, shoulders rising regularly with each downward press, palm base clearly applying pressure. Chest deforms rhythmically under compression and recoil.
shot8: Shot 8 connects via gentle fade-in/fade-out, close-up, eye-level angle. Composition narrows to patient’s upper chest and rescuer’s proper hand position. Foreground features a wisp of mist drifting across; background pavilion railing and distant mountains softly blurred in watercolor style, creating sense of calm closure. In cool soft light, patient’s chest resumes steady rise and fall, facial tension easing. Rescuer slightly retreats but maintains correct hand position as indication. Frame freezes on standard posture as conclusion. Camera slowly locks and stops moving, completing the entire tutorial with clear, reserved, standardized visual ending.
